author: Toppo225
body:
Name: Toppo225
Banned for: Apperently hacking
Banned by: SR MOD Pelpelajax
When: August 3, 4:49 pm

     To start off, I believe there has been a mistake of some sort. I was banned today for apperently hacking (Knock Back hacks as shown by banned screen). I want to clarify that I do NOT hack whatsoever and never intend to do so. I was having a normal day of playing then went AFK for a while then I decided to log off. I decided to join what I think was about a couple hours later only to come to the "disconnected" screen and be notified that I was banned. I believe there was a mistake in perhaps banning/reporting the wrong player. There could also be a possibility that I was reported during a game in a Christmas map (Nebula), where each player recieves a piece of coal that is enchanted with knockback 1. Maybe someone got confused or wasn't aware of the knock back coal. Also, from past PVP experience, sometimes when you hit a player that is in the air, from jumping, they recieve a knock back boost. I recall many times in which i was knocked back by jumping in the air while in a PVP battle. Other than that, I see no other reason for me being banned. I do not hack and would never because this is one of my favorite servers and would never want to lose the joy of playing on it. I hope this can be resovled soon. Thank you for your time (Sorry if I put this appeal in the wrong place I'm new to the forums).

                                                                                                                                                -Toppo225

I'm so sorry I accidently Archived the last one please forgive me I don't know how to work discussions here

title: Toppo225 Ban Appeal (Copy So Sorry)

replies.author: Toppo225
replies.body: Oh, now I understand. I remember playing on that map earlier. At the time (I don't know from where maybe the server or my internet connection) I remember getting serious lag where everyone would freeze and I would continue move. After the lag spike passed everything would reset to there original position and resume moving while my screen would show that I died. That could also explain why when I was swinging my sword I wasn't hitting or implementing damage to the surrounding players as shown in the video. I believe the source of my vague internet connect comes from the various devices using wi-fi on my internet network. Thanks for the video I could see what the ban was refering to.

replies.author: MidnightBeats
replies.body:
Hello. 

Unfortunately, the evidence of you hacking is very clear, and the story does not seem believable. 

Also, you are currently ban evading on an alt. I would like to remind you that playing on an alternate account while banned is only going to lower your chances of getting appealed. 

This appeal is denied. 
You may appeal again at a later time. 

Regards,
Midnite, Senior Moderator.
